info.title: MailInApp API
info.description:
The MailInApp public API (/api/v1): transactional sends, contacts, deals, journeys, webinars and courses, plus account-level webhook subscriptions (REST Hooks) for Zapier, n8n and your own backend.

Authenticate with an API key from Dashboard → Developers, sent as `Authorization: Bearer mia_live_…`. Each key is rate limited per route family (60 requests/minute unless noted); over the limit answers 429. Errors are always `{"error": "…"}`.

Webhook deliveries are signed: `X-MailInApp-Signature: v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of "<X-MailInApp-Timestamp>.<raw body>" keyed with the subscription secret>`, and carry `X-MailInApp-Idempotency-Key` (the event id) so a receiver can drop a redelivery.

get.description: The address's row in each of the account's contacts lists (or only in `listId`), most recently updated first. An empty array when it's in none. Each read is recorded in the account's data-access log.

post.description: Upserts into one contacts list, keyed by email (case-insensitive): an existing address updates in place, a new one is added. Send one contact (`email` + `fields`) or a batch (`contacts`, at most 500). Every address is verified on the server as it is written; invalid addresses are kept but never sent to. New field names are added to the list's columns (at most 40 per list).

fields.description: Field name → value. Scalars are stored as strings; nested values are ignored.

200.description: Updated an existing contact (one-contact form), or the batch's counts

409.description: The plan's contact limit is reached (one-contact form)

get.description: Every contacts list of the account, by name. No contact data.
Every deal pipeline of the account with its stages in board order, the default pipeline first. Creates the default pipeline if the account has none yet. No deal data.

post.description: A deal on one of the account's contacts. Name the contact by `email` (the most recently updated list that has it, unless `listId` is given) or by `listId` + `rowId`. Without `pipelineId`/`stageId` the deal goes to the default pipeline's first open stage. Fires the `deal.created` webhook event and any deal-stage journey.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Retrying with the same key answers with the deal it already made (200, `created: false`).

value.description: Decimal amount, rounded to cents. Default 0.

patch.description: Any of `title`, `value`, `currency` and `stageId` (a stage of the deal's own pipeline). A stage change is recorded in the deal's history and fires the `deal.stage_changed` webhook event and any deal-stage journey; moving to the current stage changes nothing (`moved: false`). Nothing is written when any part of the body is invalid.

parameters.name: trigger
parameters.description: Only journeys with this trigger kind. `api` lists the ones POST /api/v1/journeys/{id}/trigger accepts.

200.description: The journeys, most recently updated first

post.summary: Enroll a contact in a journey
post.description: For a journey whose trigger is "API" and that is enabled. Adds the address to `listId` first if it isn't there yet.

get.description: Rate limit: 30 requests/minute per key. Secrets are never listed.

post.description: Rate limit: 30 requests/minute per key. At most 50 subscriptions per account. The returned `secret` signs every delivery and is shown only here. An endpoint answering 410 Gone is unsubscribed automatically; revoking the API key disables the subscriptions it made.

delete.description: Any of the account's subscriptions, not only the key's own. Rate limit: 30 requests/minute per key.

get.description: Example deliveries, exactly as a subscription receives them, for field mapping before a real event has fired. One type with `type`, every type without.

post.description: Freeform (`subject`, `html`, `text`) or template (`projectId` + `mergeData`, sends an existing studio project). Suppressed and invalid addresses are not sent to (`status: suppressed`).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Retrying with the same key returns the first call's result instead of sending again.

post.description: Counts toward the plan's monthly Embed API quota.

403.description: Not included in the plan, or the live-session quota is reached

post.description: Sends the confirmation (or waitlist) email. `joinUrl` is null while waitlisted.
Membership-wide access, keyed off one of the account's courses. `active: false` revokes.

403.description: The Embed API isn't included in the plan

429.description: Too many requests for this key, or the plan's monthly Embed API quota is used up

post.description: A short-lived portal URL that signs the member in, for an iframe. The member must currently have access.

403.description: Not included in the plan, or the member has no access

409.description: The course's membership has no portal

get.summary: An email's live view as JSON
get.description: Used by the MailInApp mobile app. The signed live-view token in the path is the only authorization; no API key.

200.description: The block tree, theme and this recipient's state

apiKey.description: An API key from Dashboard → Developers (mia_live_…).

NotFound.description: Not found, or not this account's

RateLimited.description: Too many requests for this key

isDefault.description: Where a deal goes when no pipeline is named.

rowId.description: Stable per address: the same in every list.

status.description: pending until a double opt-in signup confirms.

verification.description: The server's email verification verdict; null when not checked yet.

skipped.description: New contacts not added because the plan's contact limit is reached.

triggerKind.description: What enrolls contacts, e.g. api, list-added, form-submitted, deal-stage-changed.

WebhookEvent.description: One delivery. `id` is stable per real-world event and is also sent as X-MailInApp-Idempotency-Key.
